$ edit b/testdata/hypercase.json  # b's registry records another description for import
$ go test  # chain-a
    the registries that own or use the lift import record different description:
          .: "Imports the export as a script, as its import/ tree says."
          ./b: "Imports the export."
        Every package that owns or uses a lift registers one declaration of it: a package that only uses a bytes lift tells by its own declaration whether an update writes the lift's cell, and so the cells past it. Declare the lift once, in a package the others import, and register that declaration.
